risk: Backslash separators and drive paths may behave differently from POSIX paths.
expected_handling: Add path normalization tests or document limitation.
notes: Path normalization documented and tested on Linux host in Phase 2. Windows filepath.Clean semantics require Windows CI in Phase 5.

risk: Rename/overwrite semantics may differ from Linux/macOS.
expected_handling: Validate restore/container rename behavior on Windows CI where feasible.

risk: Open files may prevent remove/rename operations.
expected_handling: Validate GC/recovery cleanup behavior or document limitation.

risk: POSIX permission semantics do not map directly to Windows.
expected_handling: Avoid overclaiming permission preservation on Windows.
notes: Phase 4 metadata policy documents that permission equivalence on Windows is not claimed in v1.10.10.

risk: Bash scripts may not run natively outside Git Bash/WSL.
notes: Covered by Phase 6 script portability audit.

risk: Permission and timestamp behavior may differ from Linux.
notes: Phase 4 metadata policy documents that macOS permission and timestamp equivalence is not claimed in v1.10.10.

risk: Default filesystem may be case-insensitive depending on setup.
expected_handling: Avoid assuming case sensitivity in platform claims.
notes: Phase 4 metadata policy documents that case sensitivity is treated as host/filesystem-dependent.

risk: Symlink behavior differs by platform and permissions.
expected_handling: Document support policy and test feasible behavior.
notes: Phase 4 metadata policy documents that symlinks are resolved at store time and rejected at restore time. No portable symlink preservation claimed.

risk: Timestamp precision may vary by filesystem/platform.
expected_handling: Validate restore determinism without overclaiming metadata identity.
notes: Phase 4 metadata policy documents that timestamp identity across platforms is not a release guarantee in v1.10.10.

risk: SQLite file locking behavior may vary across OS/filesystems.
expected_handling: Validate core test suite on OS matrix.

risk: Restore byte determinism may be obscured by platform-specific path forms.
expected_handling: Validate byte-identical restore output for platform-sensitive destination paths.
notes: Covered by Phase 3 restore determinism tests.

risk: Filesystem metadata behavior may differ across platforms and filesystems.
expected_handling: Define release claim boundary for symlinks, permissions, timestamps, and case sensitivity.

risk: Cross-platform tests may pass locally but fail under GitHub-hosted OS runners.
expected_handling: Add GitHub Actions OS matrix for focused path and restore validation.
notes: Introduced by Phase 5; final status requires PR CI evidence.

risk: GNU/BSD command differences may affect shell scripts.
expected_handling: Document script portability boundary and avoid claiming macOS shell-script parity until validated.
notes: Covered by Phase 6 script portability audit.

risk: Native PowerShell compatibility is not provided for Bash/POSIX scripts.
expected_handling: Document that Windows-native script support is not claimed.
notes: Covered by Phase 6 script portability audit.
